messages:
maria: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit: eval-triggered alerts, batching/caching recs, quantization suggestions. Need prioritization for next sprint. TL;DR of customer asks: 1) eval alerts (per-prompt thresholds + notif), 2) quant recs that respect model accuracy vs perf, 3) batching/caching presets for chat vs retrieval. Thoughts?

alex: +1. Suggest MVP = alerting pipeline + tiny UI to link eval -> rule -> notify. Keep batching/caching as static recipes, not auto-apply.

jin: From infra: eval alerts need a lightweight runner. Propose sampled evals on each deploy + rolling baseline windows. Must support Dedicated/Private runs.

claire: On-prem quant recs require ingesting model metadata (fp16/checkpoints) and perf profiles — onboarding time increases.

sam: Launch criteria proposal:
- Alerting: rule editor, email & Slack channel notifications, attach failing prompts.
- Recommendations: offline report with delta estimates for latency/cost for 3 representative models.
- SLO: false-positive rate <= 5% on signal datasets.

maria: Agreed. Customers asked about eval-triggered auto-rollbacks — too risky for MVP. MVP will flag + create ticket only.

alex: Agreed. Example config we can show in docs:
```
eval_alert:
  name: "chat-quality-drop"
  threshold: 0.75
  window: 100
  notify: ["#product-alerts", "team-leads@example.com"]
```

jin: Storage note: keep 30 days of eval artifacts per customer for investigations. Must scrub PII before retention.

ops-bot: infra: eval-runner v0.9 deployed to staging :rocket:

claire: Quant recs: propose three levels: safe (int8), aggressive (int4+), custom. For each provide expected latency/cost delta and estimated quality degradation.

sam: Prioritization matrix idea: score by customer demand, effort, infra risk. Add filter for Dedicated/Private enterprise requests.

maria: Decision: MVP scope — 1) eval alerts (no auto-rollback), 2) recommendations as downloadable reports (no auto-apply), 3) batching/caching docs + two presets. Target beta in 6 weeks. Blockers?

alex: Need owner for alert pipeline + acceptance tests.

jin: I can own infra changes. I'll open an infra PR and a checklist.

claire: I'll write heuristics and the metrics report template.

sam: I'll recruit beta customers and author launch criteria doc.

maria: I'll draft an RFC and ping the list when done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
